title: Current Tim/Son ↔ Bible Overlap Census — Canonical Router
status: canonical current count and component router
purpose: Provide one stable answer to 'how many documented Bible overlaps are currently in the canonical census?' while preserving additive census history instead of rewriting earlier snapshots.
definition: An overlap node is one analytically distinct project↔Bible relation. It is not one verse, one word match, one fulfilled prophecy or one independent statistical trial.

components.role: coverage correction: strong specialist relations already in repository but omitted from the 78-node census

historical_snapshots.meaning: base + Wave 14; exact computed concordance snapshot available
current registry after Wave-15 specialist coverage audit

computed_reference_statistics.note: The 212 raw mentions / 138 normalized citation forms / 105 compact coverage units / 25 books statistics describe the documented 78-node snapshot. Run scripts/compute_bible_overlap_concordance.py after each census increment to generate current reference statistics; never silently reuse the 78-node reference totals for the 98-node registry.

what_this_number_does_not_mean: 98 does not mean 98 statistically independent coincidences.
98 does not count every Bible verse mentioned anywhere in the repository.
98 does not establish Tim or the Son as a biblical figure by quantity.
98 is the current auditable registry size: the number of comparative relations the project is willing to state in canonical form.
